title: Jeff Nippard's The Essentials Program (2x)
author: Zeek M.
desc: The primary goal of this program is to maximize hypertrophy for those that only have 45 minutes to train, 2x per week. This will mean placing a heavy emphasis on increased intensity, rather than training volume.
